title: spec-dna.toml
description: Project configuration of spec-dna, read as TOML. See docs/config.md.

spec-dna.description: The pinned spec-dna version. `check` refuses to run with a binary of another version.

exclude.description: Repository path globs that are never documents (vendored or generated text). Links to them still resolve as files.

self-urls.description: URL prefixes that address this repository; a link under one resolves as a path from the repository root. `*` stands for one whole path segment, such as a branch.

roots.description: Directories of documents. A path belongs to the deepest root that contains it.

budgets.description: Size budgets in Unicode characters of body text, per document type.

max-words.description: Longest requirement sentence, in words, before a warning. Default 30.

budget.description: Default character budget of `spec-dna context`. Default 12000.

repos.description: Aliases of other repositories for `<repo>:<namespace>/<slug>` references.

pattern.description: Literal text with exactly one `{n}` (one or more digits); `*` matches any text.

path.description: Directory relative to the repository root; `.` for the whole repository.

type.description: The type of every document in the root, or `mixed` (the default) to let front matter choose.

default-type.description: Mixed roots only: the type of a document without a `type` field. Default `note`.

status.description: Status of a document of the root's default type that has no `status` field.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the root that are not documents.

legacy-ids.description: Patterns that turn existing file names into aliases, such as `ADR-{n}`.

legacy-keys.description: Patterns of existing requirement keys that are kept as written, such as `R-{n}`.

status-map.description: Legacy status words and the status each stands for, such as `released = "active"`. The target must be a status of the root's type, or of any type in a mixed root.

decision-sections.description: Headings that hold a decision's outcome, compared without case. Replaces the default `["Decision Outcome", "Decision"]`.
